document.abstract: Panasonic have been the major installer of High Definition studio's and OB Vans in Japan, and have also designed and installed the High Definition Release Centre for the ABC Network in the USA. Some of the HD Studio's to have been built by Panasonic include all 7 HD studio's for NHK, Studio's and OB Vans for Fuji (CX), YTV and NTV. This paper will discuss issues that have been confronted by the design engineers who have put these facilities together. Some of these issues are:- Monitoring Cabling Interfacing Distribution Ergonomics Customer input As part of this paper, an overview of the new DVCPRO100 series ENG products will be discussed and compared with the top end HD products that have been designed for high definition production work.

authors.bio: Stuart Pointon started his broadcast career in 1979. He trained atTCN9 Sydney in engineering and then moved on to ATN 7 Sydney where he worked in the engineering department. He worked in post-production in New Zealand for two years, and returned to Australia to work for GEC Video Systems as Broadcast Sales Engineer, based in Brisbane. He is currently the Broadcast Group Product Manager, looking after all of the Panasonic Broadcast TV products, especially the Newsroom Systems that are now starting to appear, as well as the High Definition products. Stuart presented two papers on Newsrooms and Archiving at the Sydney SMPTE '97 Conference and on the D5 VTR and Digital Cameras in SMPTE 1995.
